text:
maria.sanchez: Heads up — auditor asked for a compact ingest playbook for SOC2 evidence: RBAC change history, KMS rotation proofs, and our incident triage logs. Need to confirm what format they want.
aj: We usually hand off CSV exports + a manifest. auditor previously accepted: CloudTrail JSON + a CSV summary. Do they want raw logs or parsed artifacts?
devon: For RBAC diffs I can produce k8s RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding diffs and git history for infra-as-code changes. Output as CSV with columns: timestamp, actor, resource, change_type, pr_link.
maria.sanchez: Perfect. Also need proof of key rotation: rotation event, envelope key version, and signed attest. samir: KMS (cloud provider) logs include keyVersion and requesterIdentity in the audit event. We can pull those as JSON. Auditor wants a hashing step?
aj: They asked last time for SHA256 checksums per file and a top-level manifest.json listing checksums + origin + time range.
devon: I'll export RBAC diffs and attach PR links. Example snippet I'll produce: ```csv
timestamp,actor,resource,change,pr
2025-11-02T14:23:01Z,aj,namespace:payments,rolebinding:add,https://git/repo/pull/452
```
maria.sanchez: Good. Also they want a mapping doc linking controls to evidence files (control ID -> file path -> justification). I'll draft a mapping for CC6.1/SC-7 style entries.
samir: One snag: service account rotations — our old logs don't show the ephemeral key IDs in plaintext. We might need to correlate service-account->pod->token usage from kube-audit with KMS envelope logs. Could be manual.
audit-bot: Reminder: evidence deadline is 2025-12-05 17:00 UTC. Attachments must be PGP-signed or delivered via secure link. :warning:
maria.sanchez: Who can do the KMS proof export? Need entries with principal, key_id, event_type, and request_id. samir: I can run the query, but will need elevated read perms on the audit bucket. aj: I'll grant a scoped role to samir for 24h, will log the grant.
devon: For the CSV manifest, do we include sampling notes (if we sampled logs) or full dump? auditor prefers full for key events, sampled ok for app-level traces.
maria.sanchez: Let's aim full for last 12 months for key rotations, sampled for application-level debug traces. Note sampling strategy in the manifest.
aj: Quick Q: do we need to redact user emails or provide PII? auditor said pseudonymization is acceptable if mapping table is provided separately and stored in the evidence vault.
samir: I'll export raw JSON to a secure bucket and produce pseudonymized CSV. Will include mapping in a separate encrypted file.
audit-bot: Upload token created: https://files.redwood.internal/upload/ea12f — expires in 48h.
devon: I'll assemble a draft package and push to the upload link by EOD tomorrow. Anyone object to that timeline?
maria.sanchez: No objections. After draft, I'll run a quick internal review against the control mapping matrix.
aj: I'll record the RBAC elevation for samir in the access audit (entry: 2025-11-20T09:10:00Z, granted_by:aj, scope:kms-audit-read, duration:24h).
samir: Thanks — I'll start queries now. I'll ping when exports are ready. :thumbsup:
